value.syntax: # [doc = " A `Value` invariant refused at construction."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " ```"] # [doc = " use pn_interchange::{Simple, ValueError};"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " let err = Simple::new(21).expect_err(\"21 is `true`, which has its own variant\");"] # [doc = " assert!(matches!(err, ValueError::ReservedSimpleValue { value: 21 }));"] # [doc = " ```"] # [derive (Debug , thiserror :: Error)] # [non_exhaustive] pub enum ValueError { # [doc = " Two entries of a map carry the same key."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " `index` is the position, in canonical key order, of the second of"] # [doc = " the two equal keys."] # [error ("duplicate map key at entry {index}")] DuplicateMapKey { # [doc = " Position in canonical key order of the second equal key."] index : usize , } , # [doc = " A byte sequence offered as text is not valid UTF-8."] # [error ("byte string is not valid UTF-8 at byte {offset}")] InvalidUtf8 { # [doc = " The first byte not part of a valid UTF-8 sequence."] offset : usize , } , # [doc = " An integer outside `[-2^64, 2^64)`, which no CBOR integer denotes."] # [error ("integer {value} lies outside the CBOR integer range")] IntegerOutOfRange { # [doc = " The integer offered."] value : i128 , } , # [doc = " A simple value that has its own variant, or that no well-formed"] # [doc = " encoding produces."] # [error ("simple value {value} is not constructible here")] ReservedSimpleValue { # [doc = " The simple value offered."] value : u8 , } , # [doc = " A floating-point value outside the admitted canonical forms — a NaN"] # [doc = " other than the one the data language names."] # [error ("floating-point value is not in the admitted canonical form")] NonCanonicalFloat , }
